description: ODC: the mirror of tests/jobs/data-contract-identity.json on the InsuranceApp fixture. Data contract anchored on IDENTITY (phase 3, 2026-09-23): (1) write followed by renaming (Description of Notes, then Notes -> Remarks; Label value of the Closed record written by path, then the record becomes Done by set Identifier -- before phase 3 it failed with 'has no child Closed'); (2) expression legitimately rewritten by the platform (DefaultValue of the FK and aggregate filter cite Entities.DcStage.Closed; the static becomes DcCaseStage and the record Done; in ODC the DefaultValue is a writable ExpressionDefinition that links by key; the Label "Closed" is rewritten to "Done"); the entity becomes DcTicket and Title becomes Subject (the unique index of the spec follows by key). The wrong case (a write that had already diverged before the rename is still refused) is in tests/Anvil.Tests.Odc/OdcDataContractIdentityTests.cs.
